description:
Needs an intern or postdoc researcher to contribute to a microgrid research and development projects.  

 Responsibilities: 
 • Distributed state estimation application expertise for active distribution systems/microgrids 
 • Expertise in robust control methods for stable transient operation of a microgrid 

 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: 
 • Graduated with or in the final months of obtaining a PhD degree in Electrical engineering with major in power systems, in a US-Based University 
 

 • 3.5+ GPA 
 • Excellent understanding of modern control theory principles including optimal control, robust control, Kalman estimators. Experience in applying these principles to power systems applications. 
 • Familiarity with basic operation philosophies, control and protection concepts for various types of Distributed Energy Recourses (DER). 
 • Familiarity with the microgrid operation concepts and the regulatory requirements for DER integration. 
 • Cyber-physical security research experience. 
 • C++/C programming skills. 
 • Real-time power system simulation experience is a plus. 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
